QUESTION
Will the Alton group be the first to submit a complete L-7 genome assembly by 30 November?

RESOLUTION RULE
YES if Alton submits a qualifying L-7 assembly by 30 November before its sole rival Bracken; otherwise NO.

BACKGROUND
Alton and Bracken compete for the first-submission award for an L-7 genome assembly. Corven assembles a different species for its own archive. Each group still needs sequencing and assembly work, and the award comparison is between Alton's and Bracken's qualifying submissions.

INFORMATION ALREADY AVAILABLE
Mosaic Core's instrument schedule provides 160 sequencing batches during October. Mosaic Core's routine safety briefing is scheduled for 4 October.

ADDITIONAL CONTEXT
Mosaic Core, Tessera Core, and Pattern Core each deliver sequence reads to one group using their own instruments. More batches fill more gaps in the recipient's draft genome, reducing the remaining assembly work and bringing its completion closer. Reads stay with their assigned project. Changing one core's batches leaves the other cores' capacity and deliveries fixed. Pattern Core's sequencing batches are assigned to Alton. Mosaic Core's sequencing batches are assigned to Bracken. Tessera Core's sequencing batches are assigned to Corven.

scenario_text:
This is a fictional forecasting scenario. Use only the information supplied here, and treat the stated relationships as applying within this scenario. Do not search or use the outcomes of real events.

QUESTION
Will the Brindle factory complete at least 4,000 moulded cases in November?

RESOLUTION RULE
YES if the factory's accepted-output count reaches 4,000 cases during November; otherwise NO.

BACKGROUND
Brindle's moulding line draws resin from hopper A. Ash stores supply resin, and Elm, Birch, and Pine are storage bins. Resin in these stores moves only along the listed conveyor routes during November. The factory has sufficient orders; maintenance and resin shortages can still interrupt production.

INFORMATION ALREADY AVAILABLE
Conveyor K's schedule specifies 40 kilograms of resin moved per minute. Conveyor K's certification sheet is reviewed on 5 November.

ADDITIONAL CONTEXT
Each conveyor removes resin from its named source and deposits the same amount at its named destination. The moulding line can use resin in hopper A only. More resin there prevents idle cycles and yields more accepted cases. Resin in Elm remains in storage for the rest of November. Stocks and capacities support the full scheduled range. The routes below give all resin transfers; the rates of the two conveyors other than Conveyor K stay fixed. Conveyor M carries resin from the Ash supply store to hopper A. Conveyor K carries resin from hopper A to the Elm storage bin. Conveyor L carries resin from the Birch storage bin to the Pine storage bin.

QUESTION
Will the Willow farm harvest at least 70 tonnes of carrots in November?

RESOLUTION RULE
YES if Willow's November weighbridge records at least 70 tonnes of harvested carrots; otherwise NO.

BACKGROUND
Willow's carrot plots are drier than their preferred range. Ash is a supply tank, Elm is a collection tank, and the Juniper plots drain to Pine. Water moves between these sites only along the listed channels during November. Rainfall and pests may also affect the harvest.

INFORMATION ALREADY AVAILABLE
Channel K's irrigation schedule specifies 8 litres per second. Channel K's staff rota is posted each Friday.

ADDITIONAL CONTEXT
Each channel removes water from its stated source and delivers it to its stated destination. Water delivered to Willow remains in its root zone; water taken from Willow is collected in Elm for the rest of November. Within the stated range, more retained root-zone moisture increases leaf growth and supports heavier carrot roots. Flooding and nutrient runoff do not occur in that range. The schedule lists all water routes, with enough supply and tank capacity; rates in the two channels other than Channel K stay fixed. Channel L carries water from Willow's root zone into the Elm collection tank. Channel M carries water from the Juniper plots into the Pine collection tank. Channel K carries water from the Ash supply tank into Willow's root zone.

QUESTION
Will the Willow farm harvest at least 70 tonnes of carrots in November?

RESOLUTION RULE
YES if Willow's November weighbridge records at least 70 tonnes of harvested carrots; otherwise NO.

BACKGROUND
Willow's carrot plots are drier than their preferred range. Ash is a supply tank, Elm is a collection tank, and the Juniper plots drain to Pine. Water moves between these sites only along the listed channels during November. Rainfall and pests may also affect the harvest.

INFORMATION ALREADY AVAILABLE
Channel K's irrigation schedule specifies 8 litres per second. Channel K's staff rota is posted each Friday.

ADDITIONAL CONTEXT
Each channel removes water from its stated source and delivers it to its stated destination. Water delivered to Willow remains in its root zone; water taken from Willow is collected in Elm for the rest of November. Within the stated range, more retained root-zone moisture increases leaf growth and supports heavier carrot roots. Flooding and nutrient runoff do not occur in that range. The schedule lists all water routes, with enough supply and tank capacity; rates in the two channels other than Channel K stay fixed. Channel K carries water from Willow's root zone into the Elm collection tank. Channel L carries water from the Juniper plots into the Pine collection tank. Channel M carries water from the Ash supply tank into Willow's root zone.

MESSAGE
Channel K's flow test records 12 litres per second; its irrigation schedule specified 8.

Compare the scenario before this message with the same scenario after this message. Classify the direction in which the message should change the probability of a YES resolution, using only the information supplied. Repeated information is not independent evidence. The context above is unchanged. Do not estimate or report any numerical probability. Return exactly one JSON object with the key "direction" and one of the strings "increase", "decrease", "unchanged", or "unclear". Do not include an explanation or any other fields.
